title: The Dream Shack | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'The Dream Shack', a laid-back, effortlessly cool retreat tucked into the heart of iconic Grayton Beach. This relaxed 2-bed, 2-bath condo blends coastal charm with that unmistakable Grayton vibe: a little artsy, a little funky, and totally beach-happy. Just a short stroll from the sugar-white sand and emerald water, The Dream Shack is your cue to slow down and settle into that “Grayton state of mind.” Sip your morning coffee on the porch, hop on a bike for a breezy cruise through town, or wander through the local galleries and beachy boutiques that give Grayton its soul. When hunger hits, you’re moments from laid-back seafood spots and local favorites that feel like home. Inside, you’ll find easy going coastal décor, comfy living spaces, and all the essentials for a carefree stay from a fully stocked kitchen for slow mornings to cozy bedrooms that invite long, restful nights after sun-filled days. Whether you're sneaking away for a romantic weekend, bringing the family for a classic 30A beach trip, or chasing that relaxed Grayton energy with friends, The Dream Shack is the perfect place to land. Come experience the charm, the chill, and the magic of Grayton Beach. You'll leave with sand in your shoes and plans to come back. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps to Beach -Gulf Views -2 Adult Bikes -Fireplace -Large Covered Balcony -Fully Stocked Kitchen -Smart TVs -Full Size Washer & Dryer -Community Gas Grill -Beach Gear -Steps to Historic Grayton Beach ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 6 2 Bedrooms / 2 Baths -Bedroom 1: King with Private Bath -Bedroom 2: King with Private Bath -Queen Sleeper Sofa **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available marked as "201." Cars should be parked one in front of the other. We provide 2 bikes for your convenience! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Ray's Multi-Mountain Beach Access- Access is steps from the home! -Grayton Dunes- Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips. -Grayton Beach State Park- This is one of the most popular state parks in Florida, with massive dunes, winding trails, abundant wildlife, and shimmering 100-acre Western Lake, one of many coastal dune lakes gracing Scenic Highway 30A along Scenic 30A in South Walton (SoWal). GRAYTON BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Bustling with local culture, Grayton Beach is home to art galleries, unique shops, live music and more. The famous Red Bar serves great food, craft cocktails, wine, and beer with live bands every night. Across the street, the vibrant Zoo Gallery features decorative art, jewelry, prints, paintings, and colorful beach-inspired furnishings from select artists nationwide. Next door, Tribe Kelley Surf Post offers chic beach clothing and handpicked shore-styled accessories. Nearby, Chiringo serves tapas, seafood, and favorite drinks with seasonal entertainment. A minute’s drive away, the renowned AJ’s Seafood & Oyster Bar at Grayton Beach features delicious oysters, Gulf-caught seafood, and lively bands every night. During your stroll, be sure to check out the Grayt Wall of Art – the quirky locals of Grayton have made an everyday fence into a work of art, complete with a variety of inspirational works from local artists. Did you know that you can also hop on a charter fishing boat and reel in some fresh fish directly from the beach? In Grayton Beach, the charter boats launch directly from the sugar-white sand, which is truly a unique experience. After soaking in the sun at Grayton Beach State Park or paddle boarding on Western Lake, be sure to refuel with some of the best food in South Walton. Start your morning with breakfast at Black Bear Bread Co. or Crackings. If you plan to sleep in, Grayton Seafood Company is a brunch favorite! Lunch at Chanticleer is a must, or save your appetite for dinner at The Red Bar or Hurricane Oyster Bar. If you’re looking for a break from the beach, try your hand at creating a piece of South Walton-inspired art. The Shops of Grayton is home to the Shard Shop and Rock, Paper, Scissors, both of which offer interactive art experiences tailored to the whole family. You’ll also find former 2013 Artist of the Year Andy Saczynski’s gallery, which is home to his unique take on assemblage art. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 50 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is just over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited. *No parties or events. *Complimentary bikes (2) provided. Waiver must be completed for bike lock code. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This home must remain pet free! IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
